findings.finding: The preregistration and launch-checkpoint author timestamps postdate the earliest retained attempt marker, so Git timing does not establish that the complete launch manifest was immutable before the first model launch.
findings.consequence: Withdraw the claimed pre-launch immutability of the complete sixteen-job manifest. Per-job attempt markers still bind each request before its own retained model execution.

findings.finding: All sixteen packet_artifact_sha256 values in sealed-render-key.json were computed before the packets were relabeled from v2 to v2b and do not match the launched packet bytes.
findings.consequence: Withdraw condition-level normalization aggregation from the evidentiary report. The sample-level 15/16 transport stop does not depend on the sealed key.

findings.finding: Runner receipts call packet.json and output.schema.json the visible input files, but retained events show S06, S07, and S15 reading a global codebase-memory skill file.
findings.consequence: Treat those fields as staged inputs, not an exhaustive visibility boundary. No retained event shows a v1/v2 output read, but filesystem invisibility was not established.

retained_claims: Sixteen distinct v2b requests have retained attempt markers, completed receipts, raw outputs, and event streams with matching per-job request and artifact digests.
Blinded sample-level ingestion accepted fifteen outputs and rejected S04 because the exactly-once extracted prose contained 88 words.
The preregistered all-sixteen transport gate failed, and no semantic-adjudication or matching artifacts exist in the retained run.
Seven samples were accepted directly and eight were accepted after one exact approved unwrap; these totals are transport metadata only.
withdrawn_or_unestablished_claims: The complete sixteen-job launch manifest was immutably checkpointed before the first model launch.
The sealed render key cryptographically binds the launched v2b packet bytes.
Condition-level wrapper rates in the original report are evidence-backed by the sealed key.
The renderer could see only packet.json and output.schema.json.

review_provenance.limitation: Three fresh read-only Sol review attempts failed to return a terminal artifact. The second emitted the material integrity observations that were then mechanically confirmed. The third reported that focused verification passed but was interrupted before its AIR classification and verdict; its ephemeral thread could not be resumed. No review acceptance is claimed.

authority: Qualification of a stopped transport record only; no semantic, recognizability, ranking, selection, retry, or downstream execution authority.
